research_notes: Seek McKinsey, Treasury and King's College Hospital appointment/hours/leave records, Carla Zampatti employment and later management capacity, ABCN start-day reconciliation, solar governance boundaries and study overlaps. Verify the secondary lead for a 2007 Women's Health & Research Centre consultancy before adding a factual spell.

2026-09-29 initial avenues: APH chronology and personal biography, ABCN appointment/resignation pages and 2018/2021 reports, Tax Institute biography, public indexed LinkedIn volunteer entry, TechnoServe interview and solar-company offer document. Direct LinkedIn returned 999; no login or bypass. ABCN resignation direct link returned 404, so cessation uses annual report.

Preserve two discrepancies: ABCN announced commencement 14 August 2017 versus annual-report appointment 30 August 2017; official fashion MD end 2016 versus later press description of 2021 management. Neither supports manufactured continuous dates. Do not attribute other ABCN directors' board positions to Spender.

Searches for personal full-time evidence mainly returned jobs in the MP's office, which do not prove her own hours. CEO and MD titles do not establish full-time status. Broader company directorships and 2007 consultancy remain follow-up; record is partial, not complete.

2026-10-01 follow-up: ABCN2017/2018 governance tables and2021 annual report, employer resignation statement/archive, public professional-profile index, Treasury/hospital and consultant searches, personal parental-leave commentary, public interests-register leads. Identified separate ABCN and Foundation governance appointments; reconciled30August board date against14August announced CEO date without asserting verified payroll start. November resignation announcement is not employment cessation; nearby25November date is another director’s.

Women’s Health & Research Centre2007 consultancy remains a Wikipedia-derived lead: no independent primary corroboration found. LinkedIn returned999; ABCN PDF follow-up URLs returned404/500 redirects, while indexed extracts remained available. OpenPolitics detailed interests are subscriber-only and were not accessed; APH register query blocked by robots. No broad directorship list adopted from unverified commentary. Treasury/McKinsey/hospital hours and contracts, Carla post2016 capacity, actual CEO start and all leave remain unresolved; advance pending fresh records.

Second follow-up2October2026 adds previously omitted Harvard/Dartmouth business study from her own biography, separately from paid work. Targeted2007 consultancy and maternity-leave searches still did not identify primary Women’s Health and Research Centre appointment evidence or personal leave boundaries. Motherhood-penalty article discusses population statistics, not her own leave. Innovation Bay episode134 summary https://innovationbay.com/podcasts/allegra-spender-independent-candidate-for-wentworth/ mentions return to Australia in2007 and subsequent MD work, but does not clearly give appointment date and contains unrelated errors (calling Wentworth a Senate seat); official2008 start retained. April2025 company-family interview reports brother CEO since2019 but cannot determine her own post2016 duties. Further work needs historical employer contracts, hospital/Treasury appointment records and company governance versus operational employment evidence; no FT duration inferred.

Third follow-up3October2026: repeated exact-name searches for the claimed2007 Women's Health and Research Centre consultancy, King's College Hospital contract, Treasury appointment and post2016 Carla Zampatti capacity. Results either repeated the official/personal year chronology or traced the2007 consultancy only to Wikipedia-derived mirrors; no independent primary employer record was found, so that spell remains unadopted. Contemporary coverage variously calls the Carla role nine years or a decade and secondary tables normalise year boundaries; neither resolves the official2016 endpoint versus later family-business involvement. No appointment dates, individual hours, leave or distinct post2016 paid capacity were established. Advance the cursor and revisit only with a historical employer or corporate filing that identifies her operational role.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: focused King's College Hospital, McKinsey/Treasury and post2016 Carla Zampatti searches again returned the official year-level chronology or derivative mirrors. A2026 Forbes family-business story says she left Carla Zampatti in2017, but also incorrectly links the departure to pursuing politics; it conflicts with the official2016 endpoint and was retained only as an unverified discrepancy, not adopted. APH register searches were denied by the search service's non-retryable robots.txt rule. No employer contract, corporate filing identifying an operational capacity, individual hours or leave record emerged; advance pending archival employer evidence.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Added first-person Community Strong co-founding activity announced25June2026, separately excluded political organisation work; frozen party preserved and no AEC registration completion inferred. McKinsey/hospital/health-centre searches remain exhausted without employer archival records. Search-indexed unicorn/full-time claim belongs to Kate Thwaites in the multi-speaker Hansard debate, not Spender, and was rejected. Primary launch page links a Drive PDF inaccessible to web tool; her separate party page supplies the founding evidence. Personal leave and post2016 family-company capacity remain unresolved.
